LanguageData.Raven_Building_LiquidInputPort.label: [Raven] Liquid Input Port
LanguageData.Raven_Building_LiquidInputPort.descripti: A pipe input interface installed on the outside of liquid facilities. When placed, it directly generates a built standard Raven liquid pipe on the same tile; if a pipe already exists there, it will simply reuse it. By facing the interface towards the target building, it can input liquid from the network into the building.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_LiquidOutputPort.label: [Raven] Liquid Output Port
LanguageData.Raven_Building_LiquidOutputPort.descript: A pipe output interface installed on the outside of liquid facilities. When placed, it directly generates a built standard Raven liquid pipe on the same tile; if a pipe already exists there, it will simply reuse it. By facing the interface towards the target building, it can output liquid from the building into the network.
